title.purpose: Page-level heading, paired with a muted count/subtitle.

drawer-heading.purpose: Title bar inside a right-side drawer.

table-header.purpose: Sticky uppercase column headers, white on navy.

body.purpose: Primary cell values, form inputs, toolbar text.

caption.purpose: Secondary cell values, muted captions, badge text.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: Right-to-left slide-in/out for Win8Drawer; mount stays alive through close so content doesn't vanish mid-transition.

motion.name: scrim-fade
motion.purpose: Drawer backdrop fade paired with drawer-slide.

motion.name: action-brighten
motion.purpose: hover:brightness-110 on solid action-color buttons; the only hover feedback any button gets (no shadow, no scale).

motion.name: win8-orbit
motion.value: transform/opacity 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) infinite, staggered 0.16s per dot

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action, e.g. '+ New Tenant', drawer footer 'Confirm'/'Save'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #35979c; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2d868a; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary/Cancel Button
components.description: Outline dismiss/cancel action inside a drawer footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #111827; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f3f4f6; }

components.name: Action Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only row action with a solid status/action color fill, e.g. Impersonate (purple).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" title="Impersonate" aria-label="Impersonate"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M17 8V6a4 4 0 0 0-8 0v2M5 8h14l-1 12H6L5 8Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px; background: #7a3fc9; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 0; transition: filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #35979c; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-icon:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Flat solid-fill status/tier/onboarding tag — the only badge style in this system, no pastel variant exists.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: #0b7a44; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Table
components.description: Sticky navy header, flat white body, flat gray row hover, bordered wrapper with internal scroll.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { border: 1px solid #d1d5db; background: #fff; max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto; } .ds-table { width: 100%; font-size: 0.875rem; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table thead { background: #1e3a4c; color: #fff; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; position: sticky; top: 0; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; } .ds-table tbody tr { border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f3f4f6; }

components.name: Win8 Drawer
components.description: Signature component. Right-side sliding panel replacing centered modals for create/edit/detail workflows; navy header, scrollable body, bordered footer.

components.css: .ds-drawer-scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-drawer-panel { background: #fff; width: 100%; max-width: 32rem; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transform: translateX(0); transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-drawer-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; background: #1e3a4c; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-drawer-close { background: none; border: none; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-size: 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-drawer-close:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-drawer-body { padding: 24px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; min-height: 0; } .ds-drawer-footer { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 16px 24px; border-top: 1px solid #d1d5db; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Win8 Spinner
components.description: Five square dots orbiting and throbbing in sequence — the system's loading indicator, replacing a generic spinning ring.
components.css: .ds-win8-spinner { position: relative; width: 1.5em; height: 1.5em; display: inline-block; color: #35979c; } .ds-win8-spinner span { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 0.25em; height: 0.25em; margin: -0.125em; background: currentColor; animation: ds-win8-orbit 1.6s infinite cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-win8-spinner span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; } .ds-win8-spinner span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.16s; } .ds-win8-spinner span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.32s; } .ds-win8-spinner span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.48s; } .ds-win8-spinner span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.64s; } @keyframes ds-win8-orbit { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg) translateX(0.65em) scale(0.4); opacity: 0.35; } 50% { transform: rotate(180deg) translateX(0.65em) scale(1); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg) translateX(0.65em) scale(0.4); opacity: 0.35; } }

narrative.overview:
The super-admin panel is an operator's control surface, not a storefront — every screen is built for a small number of trusted staff scanning dense tenant/billing data and firing off state-changing actions all day. The system borrows directly from Windows 8/Metro: flat saturated color fills stand in for icons and status, everything meets at a hard 90° corner, and there is no ambient depth (no shadows, no gradients, no blur) to distract from the data. Chrome is deliberately quiet — navy headers and borders — so the only color that draws the eye is a status fill or an action button, and it always means something specific.

This is a separate visual world from the tenant-facing app, which uses its own rounded, softer styling. Never bleed tenant-facing classes into app/super-admin/**, and never bleed this flat Metro language back into tenant-facing pages.
keyCharacteristics: Flat solid-color fills for every status, tag, and action — never pastel background + colored border/text
Zero border-radius anywhere; zero box-shadow anywhere
Navy chrome for table headers and drawer headers; white content areas with 1px gray-300 borders
Right-side sliding drawers (not centered modals) for create/edit/detail workflows
A custom five-dot orbiting win8-spinner in place of a generic spinning-ring loader

rules.name: The No Pastel Rule
rules.body: A status, tag, or tier is always a solid saturated fill with white text — never a bg-*-100 / text-*-800 / border-*-200 combination.

rules.name: The 4.5:1 Floor Rule
rules.body: Any color paired with white text must be verified at ≥4.5:1 contrast before it enters the palette.

rules.name: The Uniform Caption Rule
rules.body: Every secondary/tertiary piece of text in a table cell is text-xs text-gray-700 (or text-gray-500 if muted) — never the table's inherited text-sm.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default, Always Rule
rules.body: This system never lifts on interaction. hover:brightness-110 (a filter) is the only hover feedback an action button gets — no shadow, no scale.

dos: Do use a solid, contrast-verified fill (≥4.5:1 against white text) for every status/tag/badge.
Do keep row actions right-aligned and, if icon-only, always visible (never hover-gated).
Do reuse components/admin/Win8Drawer.tsx for any new create/edit/detail panel in this area.
Do give every icon-only button both title and aria-label.
Do keep secondary table-cell text at text-xs text-gray-700 (or text-gray-500 when muted).
Do keep form labels and plain body copy dark (gray-600/700/900) — white text only on a solid, contrast-verified fill (badges, filled buttons, navy chrome).
donts: Don't use rounded-* or shadow-* anywhere in app/super-admin/**.
Don't use a pastel bg-*-100 / text-*-800 / border-*-200 badge combination.
Don't put white text on a <select> without also forcing bg-white text-gray-900 on its <option> children.
Don't use text-gray-400 for real copy — it fails contrast (2.54:1); use gray-500 or darker.
Don't bleed this Metro language into the tenant-facing app, or vice versa.
Don't add a page-level title/count block above the toolbar — the toolbar is always the first element on the page.
